name: ss Rotterdam (by WestCord)
sector: Event venue, hotel and congress ship
signal: The ss Rotterdam markets itself as a one-stop event venue for about 3,500 guests with 12 event halls and hosts company parties, jubilees and congresses.
sourceQuote: Een uitstekend bereikbaar ‘drijvend dorp’ voor ongeveer 3.500 gasten met 12 authentieke eventzalen, 20 meeting rooms, 254 hotelkamers, 580 parkeerplaatsen en meerdere restaurants en bars.
why: Framed already worked there (SS Rotterdam logo on get-framed.com), so asking their events team to suggest Framed to organisers is a warm referral, not a cold pitch.
notes: signalDate is the page's dateModified. Their Kerst page was updated 2026-10-28 (https://ssrotterdam.nl/kerst-ssrotterdam/). No public supplier list found.

name: De Kuip (Stadion Feijenoord)
signal: De Kuip published a call in late August for organisations to book their Christmas event there, for groups from under 100 up to 2,000 people.
sourceQuote: De zomer loopt langzaam op zijn einde en dat betekent dat het perfecte moment aanbreekt om alvast vooruit te kijken naar de feestdagen.
why: Their own event professionals put together Christmas parties 'volledig op maat', so being on their shortlist for an add-on reaches many company parties at once.
notes: Quote is the page's meta description (body is rendered by script). datePublished 2026-08-25 from the page's own data. Kerst page https://www.dekuip.com/nl/kerst-in-de-kuip says: 'Van een intiem kerstdiner tot een groots bedrijfsfeest ... onze veelzijdige zalen, sfeervolle aankleding en ervaren eventprofessionals'.

name: Euromast
signal: Euromast rents its spaces for meetings, receptions, product launches and company parties for up to 350 guests.
sourceQuote: Vergaderingen, zakendiners, recepties, productlanceringen en bedrijfsfeesten — flexibele ruimtes voor maximaal 350 gasten.
why: Company parties up to 350 people are the size where a photobooth gets used all night, and a venue team can recommend one supplier to every organiser.
notes: signalDate is og:updated_time. No public supplier list found.

name: Rotterdam Business Events
sector: Event agency (team outings, company parties, DMC)
signal: An IDEA-certified Rotterdam event agency with 20 years of team outings and company events, currently promoting winter and Christmas outings.
sourceQuote: Al 20 jaar dé expert in teamuitjes en evenementen
why: An agency that builds Christmas outings to order needs add-ons it can resell, and a €299 all-in booth leaves room for its margin.
notes: signalDate is the homepage's dateModified. Client testimonial on the page names an event for MKB Rotterdam Rijnmond.

name: Timeless Events
sector: Event agency (company parties, Christmas parties, own entertainment)
signal: Timeless Events organises staff and Christmas parties (case studies of 1,300 guests, one at De Kuip) and updated its Christmas party page in October.
sourceQuote: December zit snel vol. Goede locaties en entertainment zijn eerder geboekt dan je denkt.
why: They sell entertainment for staff parties, and a booth is an add-on they don't have in their own acts list, so Framed fills a gap rather than competing.
notes: Zoetermeer, about 25 km from Rotterdam. Homepage lists 'Marente – Personeelsfeest voor 1300 man' and 'Enver – 1300 Feestgangers in De Kuip'. Their entertainment page lists own acts only (DJ, live band), no photobooth.
